reason: I already give free meals to creators every month and have no idea if anyone walks in because of them, so a free tool that counts customers per creator is worth a 2-minute sign-up. I'd try it on one or two barter posts at the quietest outlet first.
objection: On a busy Saturday my counter staff will not stop to tap redeem and type a PIN, so the numbers will undercount and I'll end up thinking the creators did nothing when really the staff just skipped it.
would_change_my_mind: If after the first couple of posts the redemption count is clearly missing customers I can see in my UPI settlements, I'd drop it; if redeeming could happen without staff doing anything, I'd use it at every outlet.
